_doc: Vectors of smd_chip_sizes. Expected values are the maker numbers of the research file (Yageo RC_L, Vishay D/CRCW e3, Panasonic ERJ, KEMET MLCC, TDK MLCC), in the unit of the column.

cells.ref: 0805 body length 2.0 mm: Yageo RC_L, Vishay D/CRCW e3, Panasonic ERJ and KEMET MLCC tables agree within 0.1 mm
0805 body width 1.25 mm: Yageo RC_L, Vishay D/CRCW e3, Panasonic ERJ and KEMET MLCC tables agree within 0.1 mm
0603 = metric 1608: Vishay RR1608M and KEMET C1002 size code table
01005 = metric 0402 (0.40 x 0.20 mm): TDK MLCC Product Guide, Yageo and Panasonic bodies
0603 rated power 0.1 W at 70 degC: Yageo, Vishay and Panasonic agree
1206 rated power 0.25 W at 70 degC: Yageo, Vishay and Panasonic agree
1206 max. working voltage 200 V: Yageo, Vishay and Panasonic agree
0402 typical 1/16 W: Yageo RC_L and Vishay standard mode (Panasonic ERJ-2R states 0.1 W)
Panasonic ERJ precision thick film, 0402 rated power 0.1 W
Vishay D/CRCW e3 2512 operating voltage 500 V (Yageo and Panasonic state 200 V)
2512 typical 200 V: Yageo RC_L and Panasonic ERJ
Yageo RC_L has no part in size 1812 (series 0075 to 2512 without 1812)

lookups.ref: 1206 (0.25 W, 3.2 mm) is the first size with a typical rating of at least 0.2 W
